create_circos_garc: create a Garc arc object from a Bio.SeqRecord or NCBI accession number for circular genome visualization
build_circos_gcircle: build a Gcircle drawing space and add Garc arc objects to render a circular genomic plot
run_circos_lineplot: run a lineplot on a Gcircle arc sector with radial axis range and optional spine display
create_circos_heatmap: create a heatmap on a Gcircle arc sector using a colormap to visualize data magnitude by color
create_circos_chord_plot: create a chord plot connecting two arc sectors to visualize interrelationships between genomic regions
